concepts.title: 对数与指数互逆
concepts.summary: 对数是指数：$\log_bx=y\Leftrightarrow b^y=x$，$b>0,b\ne1,x>0$。本章学习定义、图像、法则及方程。

method.title: 学习路线
method.body: 先理解互逆，再研究变换、法则和应用方程。

en.title: Logarithms invert exponentiation
en.summary: A logarithm is an exponent: $\log_bx=y\Leftrightarrow b^y=x$, with $b>0,b\ne1,x>0$. This chapter develops definitions, graphs, laws and equations.

method.title: Learning route
method.body: Understand inverses, then study transformations, laws and application equations.

concepts.title: 尺度与自然界
concepts.summary: 教材以地震、pH及自然螺线说明对数的用途。对数尺度将相差许多数量级的正量压缩为易比较的数值。

method.title: 联系情境
method.body: 留意“倍数”与“对数差”：比值转为差值。

en.title: Scales and patterns in nature
en.summary: The opener uses earthquakes, pH and natural spirals to motivate logarithms. A logarithmic scale compresses positive quantities spanning many orders of magnitude.

method.title: Connect the context
method.body: Look for multiplicative comparisons: logarithms turn ratios into differences.

concepts.title: 术语与历史
concepts.summary: 关键术语：对数函数、对数、常用对数、对数方程。教材叙述Napier与Bürgi独立发展对数，后来人们认识到对数就是指数。

method.title: 辨别术语
method.body: 常用对数以10为底；对数方程包含变量的对数。

en.title: Key terms and history
en.summary: Key terms: logarithmic function, logarithm, common logarithm, logarithmic equation. The textbook describes Napier and Bürgi’s independent development of logarithms and the later recognition that logarithms are exponents.

method.title: Distinguish the terms
method.body: A common logarithm has base 10; a logarithmic equation contains the logarithm of a variable.

concepts.title: 职业联系：放射科医生
concepts.summary: 原书职业介绍连接医学成像与放射性同位素：X光、CT、MRI、PET、融合成像和超声。部分技术涉及放射性同位素，所以需学习辐射物理与防护。

method.title: 联系本章
method.body: 半衰期模型将剩余比例与时间联系；第8.4节练习会计算同位素衰减。

en.title: Career Link: radiologist
en.summary: The textbook career feature links medical imaging and radioactive isotopes: X-rays, CT, MRI, PET, fusion imaging and ultrasound. Some techniques involve radioactive isotopes, connecting the work to radiation physics and protection.

method.title: Connect to the chapter
method.body: Half-life models connect a remaining fraction to elapsed time; Section 8.4 applies them to isotope decay.
